full_name: Sari Nusseibeh | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2004–2005 Humanities Rita E. Hauser Fellow Al-Quds University
bio: Sari Nusseibeh, a Palestinian professor of philosophy at Al-Quds University, the Arab University of Jerusalem, was appointed president of the school in 1995.
